Hermite degree-two coefficient \(1/\sqrt{2\pi}\), exact inclusion-square identity, bounded fourth-chaos remainder, falling-factorial moment bound, orthogonal Gaussian decomposition and Hoeffding fixed-k projection reconstruct all limits. Actual standalone checker passed 385 rational identities, 55 overlap/variance bounds and 24,500 Gaussian trial diagnostics; finite tests are only diagnostics.

value.rationale: The uniform k-hypergraph degree-zonotope is a canonical convex hull, and the Gaussian mean width is a standard geometric functional. Beyond its mean, its complete exact variance and three coherent rank-scaling laws give a natural boundary \(k\asymp\sqrt n\) for fluctuation type: Gaussian, Gaussian plus independent centered chi-square, and nonconcentrating folded-normal mixture. This structure is not a narrow arbitrary parameter slice or an integer-table recomputation.
